text.p: Average yields at auctions of nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills edged down from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
Nine-month bills fell to 26.98 percent from 27.52 percent, 12-month bills slipped to 28.48 percent from 29.16 percent and 18-month bills eased to 32.17 from 32.42 percent.
There were no six-month bill sales.
Results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 10.90 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Amount sold 10.90 million UAH 20.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 9.07 million UAH 16.59 million UAH
The central bank sold 109,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills was not announced.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 32.30 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 32.30 million UAH 137.92 million UAH
Actual amount raised 25.15 million UAH 106.85 million UAH
The central bank sold 323,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills was also not announced.
Results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 75.03 million UAH 36.40 million UAH
Actual amount raised 50.65 million UAH 24.51 million UAH
The central bank sold 750,287 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills was not announced.
